correctness.rationale: For n≥3 the three polynomial identities give strict nonnegative-weight descent to an exactly a-sized, residue-bijective L-shaped normal region. Every alternative representation must pass through one of the three possible final reductions, so its weight exceeds the minimal form by at least the least admissible inverse cost; each inverse is a direct witness. Therefore the second Apéry layer has the stated exact delta. All three corner maxima and their symbolic differences are verified, including the n=3 small-width exception and the sharp n=6 switch. A distinct coefficient-pair priority enumerator checks 354,302 residue values for n=3..80; finite check is not infinite proof.

value.rationale: A first generalized Frobenius number (one allowable representation, versus the ordinary zero-representation threshold) is a natural p=1 invariant of a published parametric coin problem. The theorem gives a complete exact residuewise second Apéry layer, a piecewise cubic over every n≥3, and a sharp structural switch of the extremal residue at n=6. It is non-implied by a known p=0 formula or genus and not just computation of selected small examples.
